title: 369 km/h on the Nordschleife | Lap Record Porsche 919 Hybrid Evo
summary: Onboard footage of Timo Bernhard setting the Nurburgring Nordschleife lap record of 5:19.546 in the Porsche 919 Hybrid Evo, beating Stefan Bellof's 35-year-old time. The car reaches 369 km/h.
why: HN uses it to show what a skilled human driver can do in a car, for example in self-driving and motorsport threads.

quote.text: watching video of that run still blows my mind (I have a racing background)
